CREATE TABLE "public"."execution_jobs" (
  "attempt" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "finished_at" timestamptz(3),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lock_token" text,
  "locked_until" timestamptz(3),
  "logs" text,
  "max_attempts" int4 DEFAULT 3 NOT NULL,
  "progress" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "queued_at" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "request_id" text NOT NULL,
  "started_at" timestamptz(3),
  "status" text DEFAULT 'QUEUED' NOT NULL,
  "worker_id" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "execution_jobs_status_check_ec07928c" CHECK ("status" IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')),
  CONSTRAINT "jobs_attempts_positive_91036c8d" CHECK (attempt >= 1 AND max_attempts >= 1),
  CONSTRAINT "jobs_progress_range_dda9f613" CHECK (progress >= 0 AND progress <= 100)
)
